fflate is not in this folder yet.

The Update tab zips a folder in the browser with fflate. Add the browser build of the package as
control/static/vendor/fflate.js (in the package it is esm/browser.js). It is one file with no
other files it needs. The licence text of fflate (MIT) goes next to it as LICENSE-fflate.txt.

Until the file is here the Update tab says so and the Push button stays off. Nothing is fetched
by the service or the installer.
